summary: Master banquet and catering management. Learn RevPASH, BEO workflows, and HACCP compliance to drive profitability and service excellence. Enroll today.
lede: Banquet and catering management coordinates food and beverage operations for events, from planning and costing to service. Designed for professionals with foundational food-and-beverage service experience, this course addresses the practical task of organizing complex events while managing costs and teams. Topics include RevPASH and break-even analysis, menu and recipe costing, and preparing banquet event orders, staffing plans, and post-event reports.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals who already possess a foundational understanding of food and beverage service but need to elevate their management and strategic capabilities.
audience: Catering Sales Managers focused on high-value contract
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in food and beverage operations or event management. Familiarity with basic financial concepts (revenue, cost, profit) and standard kitchen or service terminology is required. No prior experience with specific software is necessary, though a basic proficiency in spreadsheet applications is recommended.
